content1.content: Difference Between Notifications & Other Communication Methods

content2.content: It's important to choose the right channel for your message.

content4.content: Notifications reach users outside the app. In-app messages (dialogs, banners) are for users currently using the app.

content6.content: Snackbars are for transient feedback on user actions (e.g., 'Item deleted'). Notifications are for persistent or important information.

content8.content: Don't use a system notification if a simple Snackbar will do.
